messages:
Maya: FYI AeroScale invoice INV-2026-77 ($9,880) hit an AP hold — no PO number on the invoice, only SOW-PL-2025.
Raj: Can you paste the header? if no PO we need vendor to reissue or procurement to create one.
Maya: Invoice header:
Vendor: AeroScale
Invoice#: INV-2026-77
Reference: SOW-PL-2025
Amount: $9,880
Lines: infra support monthly x6
No PO field populated.
Kim: I think this SOW was approved but procurement never issued a PO (legacy SOW handling).
ProcurementBot: POs linked to SOW-PL-2025: none. Recommended actions: (A) create PO and have vendor reissue invoice referencing new PO, or (B) AP manual exception.
Liam AeroScale: Sorry about that — our billing team uses SOW refs by default. We can reissue with a PO if you provide the number.
Raj: Manual exception slows things down. Preferred: procurement create a PO to avoid future confusion.
Maya: We need payment before month-end due to subscription renewal. Can procurement expedite?
Kim: I'll create a one-off PO 46200 today and assign an owner. Need GL/cost center.
Evan: Use cost center: Platform, GL: 7002. I'll be the approver once PO is created.
ProcurementBot: PO 46200 created. Owner: Evan. Cost center: Platform. GL: 7002. Please ask vendor to reference PO 46200 on reissued invoice.
InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-2026-77 status: waiting_for_vendor_reissue (rule 219).
Maya: Also flag: invoice line rate shows $1,646.67/month but SOW lists $1,500/month. Need change order or rate confirmation before approve.
Liam AeroScale: There was a scope extension last month (additional monitoring hours). We'll attach the change order and reissue immediately with PO 46200.
Raj: Once reissued AP can clear the hold. Maya, please confirm when vendor sends updated PDF.
Maya: Will watch inbox and forward to AP ops. Thanks everyone. :pray:
